technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer as prime contractor should have satisfactorily completed during the last five years at least one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work value not less than Rs: 1728.18 lakhs (Constructed & commissioned GLR along with Chlorination scrubber plant/ Vacuum feeding chlorination along with allied works in a single work). (If the contract contains many components all components need to be completed). The contractor should have constructed and commissioned of 18 ML capacity and above RCC water retaining reservoir with RCC roof along with Chlorination scrubber plant/ Vacuum feeding chlorination.

Executed in any one year, the following minimum quantities of work RCC of M 30 with shuttering- 5812 cum, Earth work Excavation -13600 Cum, TMT steel- 756 MT, 80 HP and above Horizontal Centrifugal pumps- 2nos, EMF Meters installed and commissioned- 2 Nos
Liquid assets or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.432.00 Lakhs (usually the equivalent of the estimated cash flow for the three months in the peak construction period.
Should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 6912.72lakh.
